label: HIVE-DRIVER
summary: Pure Node.js Hive / Impala driver using hive-driver (Thrift over TCP) with LDAP/PLAIN authentication. Ready for future Kerberos migration.

configuration.code: SQL query to be executed against Impala (e.g., SELECT * FROM db.table). Uses $name or :name bind markers that are substituted safely from request parameters.
configuration.custom_data: Connection config object with host, port, username, password, useTLS, tls, authType (PLAIN|KERBEROS future), maxRows, timeoutMs.
